chunks: And Moses said: 'Our Lord, You have given Pharaoh and his chiefs pomp and wealth in the life of this world. Our Lord, that they may mislead [people] from Your path. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they do not believe until they see the painful punishment.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Moses pray for regarding Pharaoh's wealth and hearts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this supplication is often interpreted not merely as a plea for punishment, but as a strategic divine mechanism where the accumulation of worldly wealth serves as a spiritual trap that deepens Pharaoh's arrogance and disconnects him from truth.
